platforms.description: Platforms where she may reach the owner
platforms.hint: Only the owner, only in a private chat, only on these platforms. Never groups.

block_builtin_proactive.description: Take away AstrBot's own send-message and scheduling tools
block_builtin_proactive.hint: send_message_to_user and future_task are removed from every request, so she can only reach out through this plugin (its limits, recorded in memory).

tick_minutes.description: How often she checks what is on her mind (minutes)
tick_minutes.hint: A model call only happens when there is a thought.

timing_jitter.hint: 0.2: each wait (checking, gaps, 'just talked', typing) is give or take 20%. 0: exact.

quiet_start.hint: Only used when her daily schedule is unknown; normally she is quiet while asleep (memory-core sleep_hour / wake_hour).

quiet_end.hint: Only a mistake that affects the owner is told while she is asleep / in quiet hours.

min_gap_minutes.description: Minutes between two messages she starts

share_daily_cap.description: Shares sent right away per day
share_daily_cap.hint: Time-limited ones excepted; the rest wait for the next visit.

longing_chance.description: Chance per check to say she misses you (at full longing)
longing_chance.hint: Scaled down at lower longing and at hours the owner is rarely around. Once per absence.
